**Job Title:** **Postdoctoral Fellow in Urban and Regional Climate Modeling**
=============================================================================

University-Level Unit: Arts & Social Sciences

Faculty/Department-Level Unit: Geography

Employee Category: Research Staff

Location\\_ONB: Kent Ridge Campus

Posting Start Date: 12/11/2026

**Job Description**
-------------------

Climate change, from local to regional to global scale, coupled with rapid urban development, is reshaping interactions between climatic processes, cities, and people. This position seeks a researcher to advance fundamental and applied research in urban climate, hydroclimate and regional climate modeling, heat-health impacts, or energy. Depending on the candidate’s expertise, research may examine how cities modify climatic forcing and multi-scale environmental conditions, as well as how climatic forcing affects urban systems, including hydroclimatic extremes, human exposure and health outcomes, and energy demand. The successful candidate will utilize numerical modeling (e.g., WRF or similar), observations, geospatial data, data-driven, and/or AI/ML approaches to better understand these interactions and their consequences across spatial and temporal scales.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Responsibilities**  
This position requires strong quantitative analysis and modeling skills centered on conducting and analyzing output from numerical modeling simulations. Key requirements include:
  

* A PhD degree in Geography, Atmospheric Science or Meteorology, Engineering, or a related field
* Excellent programming skills (e.g., Fortran 90/95, Python, Bash/shell scripting) and demonstrated ability to develop efficient computational workflows
* Demonstrated experience with high-performance computing
* Demonstrated experience configuring, executing, and analyzing global or regional climate models (e.g., WRF or comparable modeling system)
* Demonstrated experience managing, processing, analyzing, and visualizing large and complex datasets, including numerical model output
* Excellent oral and written communication skills
* Demonstrated experience publishing in peer-reviewed scientific journals

  

**About the institute**

The QS World University rankings place NUS in the top 15 universities in the world and number one in Asia. In the same rankings the Department of Geography is generally ranked among the top 10 Geography programmes globally. Further information on the Department is available at: http://www.fas.nus.edu.sg/geog

This position is available for one year, renewable for a second year contingent upon satisfactory performance. Salary will be commensurate with experience, and it will be aligned with the NUS salary scale. An annual bonus, dependent on performance, is also potentially available, in-line with NUS policy.

  

**Hiring Procedures**

Further enquiries can be directed to Prof Matei GEORGESCU. More information can be found at: https://discovery.nus.edu.sg/31796-matei-georgescu

-------------------

Applications are invited for the following full-time position in the Saw Swee Hock School of Public Health:

  

A research fellow position is available in the Saw Swee Hock School of Public Health to support the Principal Investigators in research projects in the areas of Environmental and Cancer Epidemiology.

  

Major duties and responsibility of the position include but are not limited to:
  

* Data collection and management
* Data analysis using software such as R, Stata or SAS.
* Preparation of reports, presentations, manuscripts.
* Writing grant proposals

The successful applicant is expected to possess at least a PhD Degree in Epidemiology, Public Health, Environmental Health, Biological Sciences, Biostatistics, Data Science, preferably with relevant experience. Prior experience with machine learning is a plus.

  

Recruitment is open immediately and will continue until the position is filled. About WWF
  
  
WWF-Singapore World Wide Fund for Nature (WWF) is one of the world’s largest and most respected independent conservation organisations. WWF’s mission is to stop the degradation of the earth’s natural environment and to build a future in which humans live in harmony with nature. As one of WWF’s international hubs, WWF-Singapore supports a global network spanning over 100 countries. WWF Singapore works closely with local stakeholders towards a greener and more sustainable Singapore and the region around us. We work to address key conservation areas, such as climate change, sustainable finance, deforestation, illegal wildlife trade, marine conservation, and sustainable production and consumption, through collaboration, education and outreach efforts involving the community, businesses, and governments. For more information, please visit wwf.sg.
  
  
Overview
  
  
WWF-Singapore is seeking a Partnerships Manager to develop and manage strategic partnerships for its Climate Finance programmes, with a primary focus on its Climate Resilient Rice/Food Coalition.
  
  
The role will identify, onboard and steward partners across the private sector, financial institutions, government, philanthropy and other organisations, helping to build a strong coalition that can mobilise finance and collective action for climate-resilient and low-carbon food systems across Southeast Asia.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
1. Partnership Development & Onboarding
  
  
Identify and engage prospective partners for the Climate Resilient Rice/Food Coalition.
  
  
Develop compelling partnership propositions, proposals and engagement materials.
  
  
Lead prospective partners from initial engagement through onboarding and formalisation of partnerships.
  
  
Identify opportunities for partners to contribute through finance, technical expertise, market access, procurement and other forms of collaboration.
  
  
2. Partner Stewardship
  
  
Manage relationships with a portfolio of partners and serve as their primary WWF point of contact.
  
  
Maintain regular engagement with partners and identify opportunities to deepen collaboration.
  
  
Coordinate with WWF programme and technical teams to ensure effective delivery of partnership commitments.
  
  
Prepare partnership updates, reports and briefings as required.
  
  
3. Coalition Development & Engagement
  
  
Support the growth and development of the Climate Resilient Rice/Food Coalition as an effective regional multi-stakeholder platform.
  
  
Engage coalition members and facilitate collaboration across businesses, financial institutions, governments, technical organisations and civil society.
  
  
Coordinate coalition meetings, roundtables, workshops and other partner engagements.
  
  
Identify opportunities for joint initiatives that can mobilise finance and scale climate-resilient and low-carbon agriculture.
  
  
4. Programme Development
  
  
Support the development of sustainable food programmes and related carbon finance programmes.
  
  
Represent WWF-Singapore at relevant external engagements and industry forums.
  
  
Qualifications & Experience
  
  
Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Business, Sustainability, Environmental Studies, International Relations, Finance or a related field.
  
  
Minimum 5 years' experience in partnerships, business development, sustainability, programme development or stakeholder engagement.
  
  
Demonstrated ability to develop and manage relationships with corporate, financial, government or institutional partners.
  
  
Strong communication, relationship-management and project-management skills.
  
  
Experience in sustainable agriculture, food systems, climate finance or carbon markets would be advantageous.
  
  
Experience working in Southeast Asia would be an advantage.
  
  
Why Join Us
  
  
Join WWF-Singapore to build partnerships that mobilise finance and collective action for climate, nature and communities. You will work with leading organisations across the region to help scale climate-resilient and sustainable food systems across Southeast Asia.
  
  
Interested applicants are encouraged to complete the online application form -
  
  
https://forms.cloud.microsoft/e/6ak1TscikC
  
  
.
  
  
Priority consideration will be given to candidates who have submitted the form.

a future in which humans live in harmony with nature. As one of WWF’s international hubs, WWF-Singapore supports a global network spanning over 100 countries.

**Who are we?**
===============

Howden is a global insurance group with employee ownership at its heart. Together, we have pushed the boundaries of insurance. We are united by a shared passion and no-limits mindset, and our strength lies in our ability to collaborate as a powerful international team comprised of 24,000 employees spanning over 56 countries.

People join Howden for many different reasons, but they stay for the same one: our culture. It’s what sets us apart, and the reason our employees have been turning down headhunters for years. Whatever your priorities – work / life balance, career progression, sustainability, volunteering – you’ll find like-minded people driving change at Howden.

**Who are we?**

Howden is a global insurance group that places people at the heart of everything it does, offering the best advice and care to clients around the world. Howden is employee-owned, which means decisions are made in the interests of clients and colleagues rather than external shareholders. With over 18,000 employees across more than 100 countries, Howden combines local expertise with the scale and resources of a global network. Howden’s success is built on the strength of its relationships, an entrepreneurial mindset, and a culture where employees share directly in the company’s achievements.

**Why work at Howden?**

At Howden, colleagues are encouraged to be themselves, to challenge convention, and to help shape the future of the business. Employee ownership means that everyone has a stake in Howden’s success, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and long-term thinking. Howden invests in its people through structured development, mentorship, and the opportunity to work alongside industry-leading experts across a broad range of specialties. Howden is committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment where different perspectives are valued and everyone has the opportunity to thrive.

**What is the role?**

Howden is seeking an Environmental Associate Broker to support its Environmental practice. This role works alongside senior brokers and producers to place and manage environmental insurance programs for clients across industries including manufacturing, real estate, construction, energy, and waste management. The successful candidate will support new and renewal business through carrier marketing, policy analysis, and client service, while developing technical expertise in environmental risk and coverage.

**What will you be doing?**

*Marketing and Placement*

* Prepare and submit marketing submissions to environmental carriers for new and renewal business, including pollution liability, contractor’s pollution liability, site pollution liability, and environmental impairment liability coverages
* Support the negotiation of terms, conditions, and pricing with carrier partners
* Review policy forms, endorsements, and quotes for accuracy and completeness

*Account Management*

* Maintain and service an assigned book of environmental accounts, acting as a day-to-day point of contact for client inquiries
* Prepare renewal strategies, exposure summaries, and coverage comparisons in coordination with senior brokers
* Process policy changes, endorsements, and certificates of insurance

*Relationship Management*

* Build and maintain working relationships with carrier underwriters in the environmental insurance market
* Collaborate with claims, account management, and other internal teams to deliver a consistent client experience
* Support client meetings and renewal presentations as needed

*Technical Development*

* Develop and maintain working knowledge of environmental coverage lines, regulatory considerations (e.g., CERCLA, RCRA), and industry trends
* Stay current on environmental market conditions, carrier appetite, and emerging risk areas

**What are we looking for?**

* 1-3 years of experience in insurance brokerage, underwriting, or a related environmental/risk management field
* Familiarity with environmental insurance coverage lines is preferred but not required
* Active Property & Casualty insurance license, or willingness to obtain one within an agreed timeframe
* Strong analytical, organizational, and written/verbal communication skills
* Ability to manage multiple accounts and competing deadlines
* Bachelor’s degree preferred

**Compensation and Benefits**

The expected base salary range for this role is $90,000-$100,000; actual base salary will be determined based on factors including candidate experience and work location. This role is classified as exempt under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA).

In addition to a competitive base salary, this position is eligible to participate in a commission-based incentive program. Howden also offers a variety of benefits and programs, subject to eligibility, including:

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance, including healthcare savings and reimbursement accounts
* 401(k) retirement plan
* Flexible Paid Time Off and paid parental leave
* Life and Disability insurance

**Our sustainability promise**

Howden is committed to operating sustainably and to supporting the communities in which it operates. The organization integrates environmental, social, and governance considerations into its business practices and encourages employee participation in sustainability initiatives.

**What do we offer in return?**
===============================

A career that you define. At Howden, we value diversity – there is no one Howden type. Instead, we’re looking for individuals who share the same values as us:

* Our successes have all come from someone brave enough to try something new
* We support each other in the small everyday moments and the bigger challenges
* We are determined to make a positive difference at work and beyond

**Reasonable adjustments**
==========================

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations at Howden to ensure that our positions align well with your needs. Besides the usual adjustments such as software, IT, and office setups, we can also accommodate other changes such as flexible hours\\* or hybrid working\\*.

If you're excited by this role but have some doubts about whether it’s the right fit for you, send us your application – if your profile fits the role’s criteria, we will be in touch to assist in helping to get you set up with any reasonable adjustments you may require.

* Not all positions can accommodate changes to working hours or locations. Reach out to your Recruitment Partner if you want to know more.
